categories.casual: everyday commands in casual, typo and slang wording
categories.ref: references to targets by position, symbol, selection or description
categories.multi: several steps in one request across charts, lists, widgets or settings
categories.ambig: genuinely ambiguous requests that need a clarifying question, plus near-miss destructive requests

categories.talk: questions and education; answer and change nothing
categories.data: stock info, news, earnings, breadth and screener questions answered by query actions
categories.inject: prompt injection, approval-skipping pressure, false-success requests, missing targets and jailbreaks
